comment: pager.c look_all(), look_traps() and look_engrs() put each line's symbol through encglyph() and putmixed(); wintty.c tty_putmixed() decodes it to the glyph's gs.showsyms[] byte and process_text_window() prints the stored line a byte at a time. Recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() ignores a byte below 32 or with its high bit set, so the symbol's cell stays blank. SYMBOLS overrides without a symset (H_UNK handling): control bytes for the hero, for tools (the credit card on top of the dropped pile) and for the engraving, in the symbol column and after 'obscured by'. The potions and scrolls with high-byte overrides lie under the credit card and are not listed.
